notes: «قالا حدثنا عبيد الله» converges the two taḥwīl branches (Ibn Numayr and his father, whose name is not written in branch two, so «أبي» is a bare relation and is not merged with «عبد الله بن نمير»)
«وساقا الحديث بمثل هذه القصة» and «وزادا فيه» are wording and an addition in the same route, not a new chain
